measurement: evidentia-measure-book, BSB source with no Strong tag of its own, --without-source-strong --learn-from KJV (Mark adds --learn-from-strong-numbers), final tier = global review + syntax-gated target gloss, at essenthos-core wt/goldscore
note: Word and link ids are this database load's and do not survive a reload; reference, position and surface are the stable key. Nothing here is applied to the corpus or to the answer key: every published EVIDENTIA figure is still scored against the rows as loaded.
drawn: sample.py: strata are passage x which gold covers the word; at least 12 per stratum, the rest proportional; random.Random(seed).sample over rows sorted by book, chapter, verse, source position, target word id
rule: A row is reclassified away from ours-wrong only after the verse was read and the reason written; where undecidable it stays ours-wrong. Two occurrences of a lexeme each rendered by its own English word are ours-wrong when we take the other one; repeated-token convention is only where one English word renders several.
